brand.fullName: Iğdır TOBB Turizm Mesleki ve Teknik Anadolu Lisesi Uygulama Oteli

footer.description: As Igdir TOBB Turizm Mesleki ve Teknik Anadolu Lisesi Training Hotel, we are a pioneer in tourism education and accommodation services.

hero.description: We offer an unforgettable experience with our 30-room modern facility at TOBB Turizm Mesleki ve Teknik Anadolu Lisesi Training Hotel.

about.pageDescription: We are at your service as Igdir TOBB Turizm Mesleki ve Teknik Anadolu Lisesi Training Hotel.
about.description1: Our training hotel, opened under TOBB Turizm Mesleki ve Teknik Anadolu Lisesi, provides students with pre-work experience while offering guests modern and comfortable accommodation.
about.description2: We offer accommodation, breakfast and dining services in a peaceful environment, away from city noise, with a view of Mount Ararat.
about.content1: Our training hotel offers pre-work experience to students with our modern facilities featuring 30 rooms (26 standard rooms, 4 suites) and a 60-bed capacity.
about.content2: Our training hotel, the only one in our province, is open to outside guests with its modern building and facilities, while also contributing to the training of students who will work in the tourism sector.
about.content3: A comfortable and peaceful family atmosphere is created with the dedicated work of our friendly staff.
about.missionDesc: To provide modern and comfortable accommodation services to our guests while training qualified workforce for the tourism sector.
about.visionDesc: To be a role model that combines education and tourism as the most preferred training hotel in the region.
about.valuesDesc: Contribution to education, guest satisfaction, quality service, continuous improvement and team spirit.
about.featuresDesc: Our services carefully prepared to provide the best experience for our guests.
about.feature1Desc: We offer tourism students the opportunity to practice in a real hotel environment.
about.feature2Desc: Our students gain experience by doing internships at Turkey's best hotels.
about.feature3Desc: A peaceful environment away from city noise, accompanied by a magnificent view.
about.feature4Desc: Fully equipped facility with conference hall, gym, restaurant and cafeteria.
about.feature5Desc: Family warmth with our dedicated and friendly staff.
about.feature6Desc: Quality accommodation service open to everyone, not just for educational purposes.
about.ctaDesc: You can contact us for reservations or questions.
